university.name: Birmingham City University
university.summary: A university based in Birmingham that teaches computing, business, law, engineering and other subjects. It has a Pakistan country page with a list of authorised agent cities, and offers an automatic tuition discount to self-funded international students.
university.eligibility_note: Listed on the gov.uk register of licensed student sponsors (Student route, status Student Sponsor - Track Record)

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.duration_text: 3 years full-time, with an optional professional placement year
courses.overview: A three-year computing degree covering programming, systems, networks and databases, then cyber security and software design in year two, with a final year that includes cloud computing, artificial intelligence and an individual honours project. A placement year is optional.
highlights: Year 1 core: Data Structures and Algorithms
Final year core: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
Final year core: Individual Honours Project (40 credits)
courses.academic_requirements: The course page lists the essential requirement as "112-72 UCAS Tariff points" (as printed) and gives no A level, BTEC or IB grades for international applicants. It directs International Baccalaureate and international qualification holders to further information not shown on the page.
courses.english_requirements: The course page gives no English test scores. BCU's English tests page states that for the majority of courses an IELTS of 6.0 overall (with no band below 5.5) is required, and that some courses may require higher.
courses.career_notes: Graduates typically work in software development, web and interface design, security and mobile computing, with MSc or PhD study mentioned as an option.
courses.notes: Entry requirements are incomplete on the page: the tariff reads 112-72 as printed (possible typo), and the A level, BTEC and IB sections are headings only. BCU's Pakistan page lists no entry requirements. Placement-year fee is stated as 20% of that year's full-time fee.

courses.title: Business Management
courses.duration_text: 3 years full-time, with an optional professional placement year
courses.overview: A three-year management degree with first-year modules in organisations, marketing, finance and data analytics, project management and leadership in year two, and strategy, change and a management project in the final year. A placement year is optional.
highlights: Year 1 core: Introduction to Data Analytics and AI
Final year core: Management Project (40 credits)
courses.academic_requirements: The course page lists the essential requirement as "112-72 UCAS Tariff points" (as printed) and gives no A level, BTEC or IB grades for international applicants.
courses.english_requirements: The course page gives no English test scores. BCU's English tests page states that for the majority of courses an IELTS of 6.0 overall (with no band below 5.5) is required, and that some courses may require higher.
courses.career_notes: The page lists careers in large corporations, smaller enterprises, the charity sector, government, consultancy and self-employment.
courses.notes: Entry requirements are incomplete on the page (tariff printed as 112-72; grade sections are headings only). The page states the 19,220 GBP fee applies to both start dates.

courses.title: Cyber Security
courses.duration_text: 12 months full-time, or 18 months with a professional placement
courses.overview: A taught master's with core modules in digital forensics, ethical hacking, cyber-physical systems security, security governance and applied machine learning, plus a 60-credit dissertation. An optional placement extends the course to 18 months.
courses.academic_requirements: A minimum of a 2:2 honours degree, or equivalent, in Computing, Engineering or Information Management. Applicants without this but with extensive industrial experience may be asked to show equivalent knowledge and skills.
courses.english_requirements: The course page gives no English test scores. BCU's English tests page states that for the majority of courses an IELTS of 6.0 overall (with no band below 5.5) is required, and that some courses may require higher.
courses.experience_requirements: Extensive industrial experience may be considered in place of the degree subject, with equivalent knowledge and skills shown.
courses.career_notes: Listed roles include security architect, security analyst, security manager, incident response manager and risk and compliance analyst.
courses.notes: Fee shown is for the 12-month route; the 18-month route with placement is 21,595 GBP in 2027/28. English scores left null because the course page states none and the general IELTS statement covers only the majority of courses. BCU's Pakistan page lists no postgraduate grade equivalents.

scholarships.name: International Undergraduate Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 5,000 as tuition fee discounts: GBP 3,000 in year one and GBP 2,000 in year two
scholarships.summary: An automatic tuition discount for self-funding international students on eligible full-time undergraduate degrees, including the graduate entry LLB. No separate form is needed. The terms seen are for 2026/27 entry.
scholarships.criteria_text: Self-funded international fee payer; full-time eligible undergraduate degree; pay 50% of the full tuition fee before receiving the CAS. Excludes foundation and sub-degree courses, part-time courses and students progressing from a BCU or BCUIC foundation year. Only one BCU scholarship can be held.
scholarships.intake_label: 2026/27 terms (September 2026 or January 2027); 2027 entry terms not published
scholarships.notes: Terms seen are for the 2026/27 academic year. BCU's Pakistan page also describes this award without a year. Do not present as confirmed for September 2027 entry.

scholarships.name: International Postgraduate Scholarship
scholarships.summary: An automatic tuition discount for self-funded international students joining a full-time postgraduate taught Master's course. There is no application. The terms seen are for 2026/27 entry.
scholarships.criteria_text: Self-funded international fee payer on an eligible full-time Master's course; pay 50% of the full tuition fee before receiving the CAS. Excludes PgDip, PgCert, research, PGCE, part-time, online and partner-delivered courses, and students progressing from a BCUIC Pre-Master's. Only one BCU scholarship can be held.
scholarships.intake_label: 2026/27 terms (September 2026 or January 2027); 2027 entry terms not published
scholarships.notes: Terms seen are for the 2026/27 academic year. BCU's Pakistan page also describes this award without a year. Do not present as confirmed for September 2027 entry.
